rca of the issue: Content-replacement was applied at the DATA layer (DB seed via migrate_real_content.py) and at the SHELL layer (index.html title, Navbar.jsx, Footer.jsx read settings.clinic_name) but was NOT applied at the PAGE layer (each page's useEffect that sets document.title uses a hardcoded string). Fix: refactor to a useDocumentTitle(pageName) hook that reads settings.clinic_name and formats consistently, OR update each hardcoded string to reference settings via the SettingsContext. Also, admin layout components (AdminLayout.jsx, admin/Login.jsx) were not migrated to consume SettingsContext.
